findings.finding: Plaintext API key (show-once secret) lifecycle is correctly bounded: stored only in apiKeyPlaintext ref, set from POST response, cleared to null in closeApiKeyModal(). Never written to localStorage/sessionStorage/Pinia, never logged. Masked view binds apiKeyMask only.
findings.reason: Meets the show-once contract; test 'dismissing modal returns to masked state' asserts the plaintext is gone from the rendered HTML.

findings.finding: Plaintext and mask rendered via {{ }} interpolation (Vue auto-escapes); no v-html. No DOM XSS sink.

POST generate/regenerate goes through useApi() which attaches X-XSRF-TOKEN for non-safe methods + credentials:include. Authorization (requireOwned) is enforced server-side (Task 8); no client-side authz to bypass.
findings.reason: CSRF protection in place; authz server-enforced.

findings.finding: console.warn on mask GET failure logs the fetch error object only; the mask GET never carries plaintext, so no secret leaks into logs.

dependency_scan: No new dependencies introduced by this task.
summary: No vulnerabilities found. The plaintext secret is handled per the show-once contract (state-only, cleared on close, never persisted/logged). Output is auto-escaped; CSRF and authorization are handled by existing infrastructure. Clipboard write of the secret is user-initiated and required by spec.
